body:
12/31/2015
I decided to try out a threshold dose to determine among other things, if it was accurate. I placed 1 mg 4aco det under my tongue and took my dog for a walk. Within about half an hour, I felt very mild body euphoria. I would consider it about the same as a microdose of psylocibin mushrooms. In an effort to determine tolerance build up, exactly one hour after dosing, I repeated the process, and then half an hour after that (+1.5 hours) repeated once more, both times with 1mg. The second dose seemed to build on the feeling, but not to the point of visuals or anything. Just a warm body feeling that was a little stronger than before but not too strong. The third dose did not change or enhance any feelings. After about 3-4 hours I returned to baseline.
I could not accurately predict how this low of a dose would affect someone. However I would be able to determine that the window for redosing to enhance effects closes at a little over an hour. Which I would think would be important.
1/1/2016
I believe it is too early (too close to the first dose) to try for a moderate/heavy experience, so I decide to place 5mg under my tongue and take my dog for a walk. Again, 30 minutes into it, I started to feel like I had just eaten some mushrooms, warm energy flowing around me
30 minutes into it, I started to feel like I had just eaten some mushrooms, warm energy flowing around me
, and I got slightly breathing objects and color enhancement with OEV. The woods opened up and I spent 2 hours in nature. It made me feel very happy and fulfilled, and made me feel like I had a ton of energy, and after my dog and I returned home, I felt the effects slowly diminish.
On 5 mg
+0 to +30-45 seems a good time frame for a come up.
+45-1:15 for the effects to come to full swing
+3-4 hours the effects started to fade
+6 hours I was back to baseline.
I will be trying at least one more dose at an 'average' dose level in two weeks (making sure I have no tolerance to its effects) to determine effects at higher levels. The low dose made me feel clear-headed, calm and warm, and made me really think about 10-15 mg would do it, however, I will need to try that dose to comment further on that aspect.
